- changelog.d/stuck-backlog-phase3c-persist-queue-pause.md:Line 5 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After the last autofix run deleted the Phase 3c "Restore queue backpressure marker", "Check queue backpressure marker" and "Save queue backpressure marker" steps, the marker is carried only by the Phase 3b "Restore queue backpressure state" and "Save queue backpressure state" steps (.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml lines 1414-1421 and 1955-1961). The changelog still says this PR adds the marker and its cache carry-over, yet the marker format and the `intervals` carry-forward already exist (`queue_backpressure_holds_dispatch` in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 18568-18569 and 18624). It also says an interval closes "when the queue drains", but `record-pause` follows `QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_ACTIVE`, which turns off only below `ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_LOW` (lines 18585-18591).
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime, but the release notes contradict the agents fragment, tell consumer-repo operators that this PR adds a cache entry to the poll job, and misstate when a pause interval ends.
  HARDENING: Reword line 5 to say the poller records queue-pause intervals in the existing Phase 3b marker, carried by the existing "Restore/Save queue backpressure state" steps. An interval opens when depth >= ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_HIGH and closes when depth < ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_LOW. Estimated lines changed: 1. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
